This file is a summary. The GSAP npm package ships no licence file — its
package.json simply states: "Standard 'no charge' license: https://gsap.com/standard-license".

## Licence

"Standard 'No Charge' GSAP License", effective 30 April 2025 (GSAP 3.13 onward).
It is a proprietary no-charge licence, **not** an OSI-approved open-source licence.

Permitted: use, reproduce, display and implement GSAP on any website, web
application or digital interface, including commercial and client work. The
formerly members-only plugins — SplitText, ScrollTrigger, MorphSVG and the rest —
are covered at no charge.

Not permitted: using GSAP inside a no-code visual animation builder that competes
with Webflow's; reverse engineering it to build a competing product; removing or
altering proprietary notices or branding.

Bundling GSAP into this site is within the permitted uses. Redistributing GSAP as a
standalone library under a different licence is not.

## What is in this bundle

`gsap-3.15.0.js` is an esbuild bundle exposing `gsap`, `ScrollTrigger` and
`SplitText`. Call `gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger, SplitText)` before using the
plugins. No notice text was stripped from the proprietary code.
